scripts.desktop:dev: npm run desktop:mlx:build && npm run desktop:mlx:stage && npm run desktop:scheduler:build && PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/rustup/bin:$PATH" npm --prefix apps/mac run tauri dev -- --config src-tauri/tauri.dev.conf.json
scripts.desktop:check: npm --prefix apps/mac run check && PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/rustup/bin:$PATH" npm --prefix apps/mac run test:native
scripts.desktop:qa:renderer: npm --prefix apps/mac run build && node apps/mac/scripts/qa-desktop-renderer.mjs
scripts.desktop:mlx:build: cd apps/mac/native/mlx-helper && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcodebuild build -quiet -scheme CodelitMLXHelper -destination 'platform=macOS,arch=arm64' -configuration Release -derivedDataPath "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/codelit-mlx-build" -skipPackagePluginValidation -skipMacroValidation CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
